description: Building Footprints is a data set deposited in ICPSR by its authors Office of the Chief Technology Officer. The dataset contains polygons representing planimetric buildings, created as part of the DC Geographic Information System (DC GIS) for the Office of the Chief Technology Officer (OCTO). These features were originally captured in 2015 and updated in 2017, 2019, 2021 and 2023. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and ICPSR normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-icpsr-repository.
